content.short: ION Finance is a TON DEX with central limit order books, liquidity books, and launchpad features.
content.description: ION Finance is an advanced DEX for The Open Network. TON App describes central limit order books for trading on user-defined terms, liquidity books for flexible liquidity management, and launchpad support for new TON projects. The product is meant to improve capital efficiency and give traders more control than a basic swap interface. For ION Finance, the TON value is the specific DeFi action it enables, from market access and routing to yield, liquidity, or position management.
